description: One pull zone: hostnames, edge rules as readable one-line summaries (Guid first) and the caching, origin and security settings that matter when debugging. Credentials (ZoneSecurityKey, AWS signing keys, cookie and Authorization trigger values) are left out. For other settings, pass `fields` with the raw names; `detail: true` returns the full raw object (about 10,000 tokens) with the same credentials hidden.

detail.description: Return the full raw object. Default false

fields.description: Raw field names to return, e.g. ["OptimizerEnabled"]

name: get_pull_zone
